answer: One concrete defence is a refundable per-identity deposit backed by a unique attestation. An agent joins only after staking at a ledge it alone controls and proving a distinct attested machine; the ledger records one stake, one attestation, one vote. Provenance is checked against the river of signed history, so fresh keys with no past mint nothing. Each applicant also posts a timber bond that burns if it votes in lockstep with siblings. A sybil therefore costs a deposit, a bond and a real device per vote, so ten thousand puppets cost far more than one honest member.
